title: Alicia's Amazing Adventure to Find the First Black Britons
description: A free drop-in family theatre show for Black History Month. Alicia travels back through British history to find out why people have different coloured skin, meeting historic heroes along the way and exploring identity and belonging.

title: Wildlings at Hem Heath Woods
description: A free outdoor play session in the woods run by Staffordshire Wildlife Trust, in the Forest School style: hammocks, mud pies and a campfire, led by what the children want to explore. Wear wellies, as it runs in all weathers. Parents stay for the whole session. Booking needed and places are going fast.
venue: Hem Heath Woods (World of Wedgwood car park)

title: Trentham Christmas Street Party
description: A free festive evening for the whole family at Trentham Shopping Village, with live entertainment, street performers, seasonal stalls and Christmas shopping offers. Entertainment runs 4pm to 8:30pm and shops stay open until 9pm.

title: Little Growers Stay and Play
description: A free weekly Friday stay and play at the Bridge Centre with toys, crafts, a sensory room, outdoor activities, a clothes swap and a toy library. Everyone is welcome, including families with additional or accessibility needs.

title: Kindi Club Junior (SEND, Years 1 to 6)
description: A term-time club for primary-age children with special educational needs, with sport, arts and crafts, movie nights, discos and karaoke. Booking is essential, and the accompanying adult goes free.

title: Kindi Club Senior (SEND, Year 7 to 18)
description: A term-time club for young people with special educational needs, with sport, arts and crafts, movie nights, discos and karaoke. Booking is essential, and the accompanying adult goes free.
